title: Set Up Your Payment Account
description: Create a new payment account, verify your identity, and add a payout method so you can receive funds.
guidance: Sellers are individuals and small businesses. Many are opening their first business account, so explain any banking term briefly.

endpoints.title: Create Account
endpoints.description: Register your account and choose whether it is for an individual or a business.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Email Address
fields.description: We'll use this to contact you and verify your account.

fields.name: fullName
fields.label: Full Name
fields.description: As it appears on your government ID.

fields.name: accountType
fields.label: Account Type
fields.description: Select whether you're signing up as an individual or a business.

endpoints.guidance: Sellers often type their shop's name here; the full name must be the account owner's legal name as on their ID.

endpoints.title: Verify Identity
endpoints.description: Provide the verification details that apply to the account type you selected. Fields that do not apply to your account type will be hidden automatically.

fields.name: dateOfBirth
fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.description: Required for individual accounts. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: governmentIdNumber
fields.label: Government ID Number
fields.description: Required for individual accounts. Enter your passport, driver’s license, or national ID number.

fields.name: residentialAddress
fields.label: Residential Address
fields.description: Required for individual accounts. Your home address (street, city, state, ZIP/postal code).

fields.name: legalBusinessName
fields.label: Legal Business Name
fields.description: Required for business accounts. The exact legal name registered with the government.

fields.name: taxIdNumber
fields.label: Tax ID Number
fields.description: Required for business accounts. Enter your business's tax identification number.

fields.name: businessRegistrationNumber
fields.label: Business Registration Number
fields.description: Required for business accounts. The identifier issued when your business was registered (e.g., company number).

fields.name: businessAddress
fields.label: Business Address
fields.description: Required for business accounts. The registered office address of your business.

fields.name: industryCategory
fields.label: Industry Category
fields.description: Required for business accounts. Choose the sector that best describes your business.

endpoints.title: Add Payout Method
endpoints.description: Enter the bank account details where you want to receive payouts.

fields.name: bankName
fields.label: Bank Name
fields.description: The name of the bank where you hold the account.

fields.name: accountHolderName
fields.label: Account Holder Name
fields.description: Name exactly as it appears on the bank account. Should match the name you provided earlier (individual full name or business legal name).

fields.name: routingNumber
fields.label: Routing Number
fields.description: The 9‑digit routing number for your bank.

fields.name: payoutAccountType
fields.label: Account Type
fields.description: Select whether payouts should go to a checking or savings account.

endpoints.guidance: The account holder name must be written entirely in capital letters, exactly as the bank prints it on statements.
